protectedDataPreserved: login state, cookies, credential stores, and session storage

quarantine.manifestDigestCanonicalization: For each files[] record in array order, hash UTF-8 source + NUL + destination + NUL + decimal size + NUL + lowercase sha256 + LF.

prerequisites: Stop verified BlankSeed-owned Electron and Node processes.
Confirm each original destination is absent; never overwrite current Runtime data.
Restore only the requested quarantine batch and verify hashes after moving.
rollback.procedure: Move each file from destination back to source using this manifest, fail on any collision, then verify size and sha256.
